rules.statement: No appeal lies from a judgment entered by the Commissioner of Requests for an action essentially seeking damages consequent upon the breach of contract, unless certain circumstances are met.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 12 of Ordinance No. 12 of 1895 provides that there shall be no appeal from any final judgment pronounced by a Court of Requests in any action for 'debt, damage, or demand,' except in certain circumstances which need not be noticed here.
